reason: The slides are nice to look at, but it is the studio talking about its own letters and logo. Nothing shows a business like mine that they rebranded, what it looked like before and after, or what it cost. I might drop a comment for a free look because it costs me nothing, but I would not pay anyone off this carousel.
objection: A free first look usually turns into a sales call, and I have no idea what I would be paying for or how much it is.
would_change_my_mind: Real before-and-after work from hotels or clinics like mine, with a clear price range I can see before I speak to anyone.
